name: Low Expectations
description: What do you mean get a job? The job market's all smoke and mirrors these days.
author: Anonymous Freelance Administrator

name: Compact Zoning
description: You think you can just slap an extractor anywhere and call it a day? There's processes to this! Processes!
author: Alex Mikhael, Ops Chief, Cruor

name: Interstellar Logistics
description: See, traders are a lot like moths. You just got to shine the light reaaaal bright, like this, and...
author: Lila Rose, Portmaster

name: Ground Operations
description:
We stand so they may sleep. We fight so they may live.
We are the shield, the sword, and we will persist in their stead.
author: Corporal Jeng-Hao, hegemony marine

name: Orbital Operations
description:
Only children are scared by the red-orange-blue of our engine plumes.
Once you age, you realize the black is to be feared - because then, we are gone.
author: Anonymous fleet commander

name: Luddic Faithful
description:
The shepard extended her arms to the flock, and announced, "Come, come!"
And so they came, all of them, even the doubters. And before them they faced a banquet, a forest, an apple tree, and a smile...
author: Book of Ludd, Verse 23:9

name: Quality Control
description: You simply cannot beat the best.
author: Unknown Culann Starworks Official

name: Rapid Construction
description:
"Oh, you can't do that, because of safety, because of budget, because-"
(Sound of something thumping, a sigh) Ever been hounded by starving scavs? Yeah. Talk to me about safety then.
author: Unknown maintenance worker, thanatos colony collapse interview

name: Profit Maximizing
description:
...in this chapter of "Profit Maximizing Strategies For The Simple And Sharp Minded", we will introduce you to one critical concept...
Synergy!
author: Excerpt from Tri-Tachyon economics booklet

name: Safety Protocols
description:
Twenty three. That's a statistic. But that makes up nearly three hundred grieving relatives, friends... and those lost lives. 
I won't let this happen again.
author: Administrator Xao, post-mine collapse interview

name: Damage Mitigation
description:
You learn or thing or two, spendin' ten cycles as the chief engineer of a battleship. Like where they're gonna hit, what's gonna blow up first, and most importantly?
What you gotta do.
author: Ex-Administrator Capascin, Ragnar Complex
